description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing trainers data, including state variables (items, loading, error) and setter methods for each.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the trainers items in the store.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading flag indicating whether trainers data is being fetched or processed.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error state related to trainers operations.
